name: Singapore — December 2025
change_summary: The law as it stood in December 2025: the 2025 CPF tables — above-55-to-60 at 32.5% (15.5% employer, 17% employee), above-60-to-65 at 23.5% (12% / 11.5%), the ordinary-wage ceiling $7,400 — with the same SDL, self-help-group, work and leave rows as the 1 January 2026 version, which succeeds it with the 2026 senior-worker step and the $8,000 ceiling.

work_rules.authority: Employment Act 1968 Part 4. s.38(4) — work beyond normal hours is paid at not less than one and a half times the hourly basic rate of pay (in this form since 1 March 1996, Act 36 of 1995). s.38(5) 72 overtime hours a month; s.38(8) 12 hours in any one day. s.38(1)(a) a break after more than 6 consecutive hours; s.38(1)(c) at least 45 minutes in the aggregate where work requiring continual attendance runs 8 consecutive hours. s.36 one rest day a week, and where a monthly roster is drawn up not more than 12 days between two rest days. s.37(3) rest-day pay at the employer's request. s.88 a public holiday falling on a rest day is observed on the next working day. s.35 and the First Schedule: Part 4 applies to a workman earning a basic monthly salary of not more than SGD 4,500 and to a non-workman (other than a manager or executive) earning not more than SGD 2,600.

name: Singapore
change_summary: CPF rates in force from 1 January 2026 (senior workers above 55–60 at 34%, above 60–65 at 25%), the SGD 8,000 Ordinary Wage ceiling, SDL, the four self-help group schedules, the Employment Act Part 4 regime, and Shared Parental Leave at 6 weeks for children born or with a Formal Intent to Adopt from 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026.

name: Singapore — 1 April 2026
change_summary: Shared Parental Leave rises to 10 weeks for children born, or with a Formal Intent to Adopt, on or after 1 April 2026, including the reviewed estimated-delivery exception. No CPF, SDL, SHG or Part 4 figure moves on that date.

name: Singapore — 2027-01-01
change_summary: The senior-worker CPF step on 1 January 2027: above 55–60 to a 35.5% total (employer 16.5%, employee 19%, ceiling amounts 1,320/1,520, graduated coefficient 0.57) and above 60–65 to 26% (13%/13%, 1,040/1,040, 0.39). Every other ladder, SDL, the SHG funds and all leave definitions are unchanged.
